newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks extend early losses to end down.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks extend early losses to end down.

text.p: Madrid stocks extended early losses to end lower on Monday in what traders saw as a small correction to recent sharp gains. Dealers could not rule out further losses in the short term.
The general index closed 6.45 points, 1.37 percent, down at 464.25, while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares ended 81.35 points, 1.51 percent, down at 5,296.53.
Dealers said trade had been subdued with 67 billion pesetas changing hands.
"The market is taking a break and despite a more or less positive background we're not seeing any new funds and we could fall a bit further in the short term," said one dealer.
Among individual stocks, Telefonica was the most actively traded, ending down 55 pesetas at 3,240.
In the electricity sector, Endesa slipped 290 pesetas to 8,510, while Iberdrola fell 15 pesetas to 1,595.
Among banks, BBV, BCH and Santander all slipped more than 1.2 percent.
